ui.title: Chore Quiz
ui.p: Tap your icon and rate each idea from 1 to 10. 10 = love it! Not sure? Tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead.
ui.other: Instead of "%s", how would you do it? Say it or type it.

about: Stars & chores is already on the hub, but Dad and Claude guessed at the chores, the star values and the prizes. This quiz lets all four of us decide how it should really work.
First how the chore chart works, then which chores go on it, then house rules (screens, weekends, game days), then a few just for you. Stars and prizes have their own quiz: ⭐ Stars quiz.
Cards marked like this are already in Stars & chores. A low number means take it out or change it.
Cards marked Skylight are how Skylight's chore chart works, which lots of families use.
Rate each card 1 to 10 (10 = love it, 1 = no way), or tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead. Parents also rate the kids' cards. Got your own idea? Tap 🎤.

ideas.title: Chores split into Morning, After school and Evening
ideas.desc: The chart shows three groups so you only see what's due right now.

ideas.title: Mom & Dad are on the chart too
ideas.desc: Like Skylight: everyone gets a column, so the kids can see the parents doing their part.

ideas.title: Check chores off from your iPhone
ideas.desc: Not just the kitchen screen. Check it off from your phone or iPad anywhere in the house.

ideas.title: Big picture tiles you tap
ideas.desc: Each chore is a big tile with a picture. Tap it and it turns into a check mark.

ideas.title: Confetti and a sound when you finish
ideas.desc: A little celebration when you check off a chore, and a bigger one when the whole list is done.

ideas.title: Say "I'm done with dishes"
ideas.desc: Say it out loud to the hub and it checks the chore off for you.

ideas.title: Mom or Dad checks big chores first
ideas.desc: For big jobs like a clean room, a parent gives a thumbs up before the stars count.

ideas.title: Reminders if a chore isn't done
ideas.desc: If a chore isn't done by its time (like backpack by 8 PM), the hub shows your name and the chore on the screen.

ideas.title: Take turns on shared chores
ideas.desc: Shared jobs like the dishwasher switch every week: Nellie this week, Nash next week.

ideas.title: Bonus jobs board
ideas.desc: Extra jobs (wash the car, rake leaves) are posted for extra stars. First one to claim it gets it.

ideas.title: Training workouts earn stars too
ideas.desc: Finishing your Training Hub workout counts like a chore.

ideas.title: Make your bed
ideas.desc: Every morning.

ideas.title: Dishes to the dishwasher
ideas.desc: Your own dishes after meals.

ideas.title: Unload the dishwasher
ideas.desc: Put the clean dishes away.

ideas.title: Set or clear the table
ideas.desc: Before or after dinner.

ideas.title: Tidy your room
ideas.desc: Floor picked up and things put away.

ideas.title: Put laundry away
ideas.desc: Clean clothes folded and in drawers.

ideas.title: Do your own laundry start to finish
ideas.desc: Wash, dry, fold and put away. Once a week.

ideas.title: Backpack ready for tomorrow
ideas.desc: On school nights.

ideas.title: Homework done
ideas.desc: On school days.

ideas.title: Sports bag packed, uniform washed
ideas.desc: Before practices and games: shoes, water bottle, uniform, knee brace.

ideas.title: Trash and recycling out
ideas.desc: Bins to the curb on trash day and back after.

ideas.title: Vacuum or wipe a bathroom
ideas.desc: A bigger weekly job, like Saturday morning.

ideas.title: Help cook dinner once a week
ideas.desc: Pick a recipe and help make it.

ideas.title: Shovel snow / yard work
ideas.desc: Minnesota special: shovel in winter, help with the yard in summer.

ideas.title: Read 20 minutes
ideas.desc: Any book counts.

ideas.title: Phone on the kitchen charger by bedtime
ideas.desc: Devices sleep in the kitchen, not in bedrooms.

ideas.title: Shower and brush teeth
ideas.desc: On the evening list as a quick check.

ideas.title: No screens until today's chores are done
ideas.desc: Screen time unlocks after the list is checked off.

ideas.title: Lighter chores on weekends
ideas.desc: Fewer daily chores Saturday and Sunday, plus one bigger weekly job.

ideas.title: Game and tournament days pause chores
ideas.desc: Like trip mode, chores are off on tournament days and streaks don't break.

ideas.title: Trip mode
ideas.desc: Turn chores off while we travel. Streaks stay safe.

ideas.title: Do your sibling's chore for their stars
ideas.desc: If Nash does Nellie's chore, Nash gets the stars (when both agree).

ideas.title: Lock the Mom & Dad tab with a code
ideas.desc: Right now anyone can open it. A 4-digit code would keep kids from pricing their own wishes.

ideas.title: Weekly chore report on our phones
ideas.desc: Sunday night: what each kid finished, stars earned and spent, and streaks.

ideas.title: Skincare AM & PM on my chart
ideas.desc: My morning and night skincare steps as check-offs.

ideas.title: Brain teaser of the day for a bonus star
ideas.desc: Solve the daily puzzle and get an extra star.

ideas.title: Coach view: charts of stars and streaks
ideas.desc: Weekly graphs per kid, like game stats.

ideas.title: Classroom-style job board
ideas.desc: Like a 4th grade class: jobs with titles (Dish Captain, Trash Boss) that switch every week.
